x-m-el-econ-02.material: I-T-shirt enentengo ebhaliwe engu-50,000원 isethengiswa ngesaphulelo esingu-30%. Esikhaleni sokukhokha, ukusebenzisa u-'coupon yesaphulelo esengeziwe engu-10%' kususa elinye u-10% enanini lokukhokha lamanje. Ngezansi indlela umngani abala ngayo intengo yokugcina.

x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funda futhi ukuthi inkinga ithi i-coupon isusa saphulelo kunani liphi.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola, usuka phezulu, umugqa owodwa ngesikhathi, ukuthi inani elitholwe emgqeni ngamunye lihambisana nencazelo yenkinga yini.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.line.0: Isaphulelo esingu-30% entengweni ebhaliwe engu-50,000 won sinikeza u-50,000 × 0.7 = 35,000 won.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.line.1: I-coupon ingu-10%, ngakho isusa elinye u-5,000 won, okungu-10% ka-50,000 won.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 yindawo yokuqala engalungile. U-10% we-coupon usebenza ku-35,000 won osevele unesaphulelo, hhayi entengweni ebhaliwe engu-50,000 won. x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.prompt: Akha ukuhlanganiswa kwezaphulelo ezimbili ezilandelanayo okwenza intengo yokugcina ibe ngu-72% wentengo ebhaliwe. Ukushintshanisa ukulandelana kuka-a no-b kubalwa njengokuhlanganiswa okufanayo. Faka ukuhlanganiswa okungu-2 okuhlukile.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala nquma ukuthi intengo iyiphesenti elingakanani lentengo ebhaliwe ngemva kwesaphulelo sokuqala, bese ucabanga ngangemva kwesibili.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi (100−a) ephindaphindwe ngo-(100−b) kufanele alingane nani.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.hint.2: Njengoba (100−a)(100−b)=7200, uma ukhethe u-a, u-b unqunyiwe. Khetha amanani ambalwa ka-a bese uthola u-b.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Zombili ziyizinombolo ezigcwele ezisuka ku-1 kuya ku-99.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.fail.c1: U-a no-b kufanele babe yizinombolo ezigcwele ezisuka ku-1 kuya ku-99.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Intengo yokugcina akuyona u-72% wentengo ebhaliwe. Hlola ukuthi (1−a/100)×(1−b/100) ulingana no-0.72 yini.

Lokhu kuphela ukuhlanganiswa okubili kwezinombolo ezigcwele (ngaphandle kwalabo abahluka ngokulandelana kuphela). Izamba zamazinga amabili esaphulelo (30, 29) zihlukile kuzinga eliphelele lesaphulelo elingu-28%.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha olunye lokuhlanganiswa owakwenza bese uchaza ukuthi kungani isaphulelo esiphelele singu-28% nakuba isamba samazinga amabili esaphulelo singesiso u-28.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala umugqa o-1 ushintsho ngalunye, ubonisa ukuthi intengo isuka kuphi iya kuphi.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kuqala sho ukuthi isaphulelo sesibili sisekelwe kunani liphi.

x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Isaphulelo sesibili sisekelwe enanini elinesaphulelo, hhayi entengweni ebhaliwe, ngakho sisusa ngaphansi kuka-10% wentengo ebhaliwe. Yingakho izinga eliphelele lesaphulelo lincane kunesamba samazinga amabili esaphulelo.
x-m-el-econ-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Izinga lesaphulelo sesibili liphindaphindwa enanini ngemva kwesaphulelo sokuqala, ngakho amazinga awengezwa.

x-m-el-econ-03.title: Ukushintshana Kwemali: Yikuphi Okunikeza Okuningi?
x-m-el-econ-03.goal: Ngaphambi kokuqhathanisa amahhovisi amabili okushintshana, hlela ukuthi yini enye edingekayo, bese uthola ukuthi inombolo ephuthile ingaba kuliphi ibanga lapho isiphetho sishintsha khona.

Ihhovisi B: 1 dollar = 1,380원, inkokhelo ichazwe kuphela ngokuthi 'ukuthuthukiswa okukhethekile kuyaqhubeka,' ngaphandle kwenombolo enikeziwe.

x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kucezu ngalunye lolwazi, zibuze ukuthi ukulwazi kungashintsha yini inani lamadola amahhovisi amabili awanikezayo.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gcina kuphela izinombolo ezinquma ukuthi uthola amadola amangaki.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.b: Amahora okuhweba nezindawo zezakhiwo zamahhovisi amabili okushintshana
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.b: Lolu ulwazi lwansuku zonke olungahlobene ngqo nokushintshana kwemali. Hlunga ukuthi ulwazi olushintsha inani lamadola yini.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi inkokhelo yehhovisi lokushintshana 나 ikhokhiswa njengephesenti lenani elishintshiwe noma njengenani elimisiwe
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.c: Udinga ukwazi ukuthi inkokhelo ikhokhiswa kanjani ukubala inani lamadola olitholayo ngempela. Ukhombe ulwazi oludingekayo kanye nenombolo.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.o.d: Isibikezelo sokuthi izinga lokushintshana lizonyuka noma lehle ngenyanga ezayo
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.d: Umbuzo wokuthi iliphi ihhovisi eliphuzayo namuhla awudingi isibikezelo sesikhathi esizayo. Cabanga ukuthi izinombolo ezisetshenziswa ekuqhathaniseni zivela kuphi.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.r.e: Ukwazi inani olidingayo kuhlukile ekunqumeni ukuthi yimuphi unikeza okuningi.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s1.explain: Uma ungayazi inombolo yenkokhelo nokuthi leyo nkokhelo ikhokhiswa kanjani, awukwazi ukubala ukuthi ihhovisi lokushintshana 나 linikeza amadola amangaki ngempela. Isisekelo samazinga amabili okushintshana (namuhla, ukuthenga imali) sesivele sinikeziwe esaziso. Izibikezelo zesikhathi esizayo, amahora okuhweba, nezinhlelo zesabelomali azisetshenziswa ekuqhathaniseni kwanamuhla.
x-m-el-econ-03.s.s2.prompt: Ake izinga lenkokhelo ye-Exchange B libe ngu-f%, futhi cabanga ukuthi ngenxa yenkokhelo inani olikhokha ngempela ngedola ngalinye liba ngu-1,380 × (1 + f/100)원. x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uqhathanise ukuthi iliphi elikhulu entengweni ngayinye: inani abantu abafuna ukulithenga noma inani abantu abafuna ukulithengisa.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.hint.1: Iphoyinti lapho uhlangothi olukhulu lushintsha likutshela ukuthi intengo yokulingana iphi.

x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Ku-10,000원, inani elidingekayo (90) likhulu kakhulu kunenani elihlinzekiwe (30). Abantu abaningi abakwazi ukuthenga, ngakho intengo ivame ukukhuphuka.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kunikezwa okuningi kunokufunwayo, ngakho amabhokisi ayasala futhi intengo izokwehla.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Bheka futhi ukuthi iliphi elikhulu, inani elidingekayo noma inani elihlinzekiwe. Ufunde isiqondiso sezinombolo ethebuleni ngokuphambene.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kufunwa okuningi kunokunikezwa, ngakho abanye abantu abakwazi ukuthenga futhi kunengcindezi yokuba intengo ikhuphuke.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ubonise ngokulungile lokho okwenzeka uma inani elidingekayo likhulu kunenani elihlinzekiwe.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Noma amanani athengiwe nathengisiwe ehluka, intengo ayishintshi.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uma amanani engafani, abathengi noma abathengisi bazoba nokukhathazeka. Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani ngokulandelayo.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ngedatha yentengo eyodwa kuphela, akukho sinqumo esingenziwa.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Noma ngentengo eyodwa, ukuqhathanisa inani elidingekayo nenani elihlinzekiwe kukuvumela ukuthi usho ukuthi intengo izoya ngakuphi.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Uma intengo yaba ngu-20,000원: abathengi bafuna amabhokisi angu-70, abathengisi bafuna angu-50.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Cishe ngentengo ephi inani abantu abafuna ukulithenga nenani abantu abafuna ukulithengisa kuyalingana (intengo yokulingana)?

x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ezintengweni zombili, inani elifunwayo laliphezulu. Cabanga ukuthi intengo kufanele ikhuphuke noma yehle lapho inani elifunwayo likhulu.
x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Noma ku-20,000원, inani elidingekayo ngu-70 futhi inani elihlinzekiwe ngu-50, ngakho asekalingani.

x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uma intengo iphansi, abantu abaningi bafuna ukuthenga futhi abantu abambalwa bafuna ukuthengisa. Isiqondiso siphambene.

x-m-el-econ-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Intengo yokulingana nenani elithengiswayo kuleyo ntengo kungakanani cishe?
